structured_output.summary: The draft is a JSON-only third track that matches B10's scope and the S6 thumbnail, with no feasible way for it to self-overlap. Every criterion can be tested through the exported registry, trackLayout, the bot race helpers or the race scene's prop cells, and each fails on main because the track doesn't exist yet. Adding the track breaks no existing test (Bramble Bends stays first, and the wrap and every-track bot tests still hold), no open PR touches these files, and the playtest steps are concrete.

findings.claim: Existing every-track tests will also run on Hay Loop. In tests/sim/bot.test.ts, each 2-bot lap must fall between 0.9× and 1.5× of length/25 s for seeds 1, 2, 3, 42 and 1234. In tests/game/six-car-race.test.ts, a seed-7 six-car race must finish within 5 minutes with five distinct AI finish ticks. The draft doesn't mention them, and a slow hairpin could push 2-bot laps past 1.5× the ideal lap time.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: run the full suite, not just the new files. Keep the layout around 1150–1350 units so a 48–56 s median also sits inside bot.test's 0.9–1.5× ideal bounds, and make the hairpin wide enough that two bots don't stall in it.

findings.claim: The backlog calls Hay Loop 'a second track', but bends and dust-bowl are already registered. The draft rightly treats it as the third track, after dust-bowl in file-name order. The S6 thumbnail's end loop looks as if it crosses itself, and the flat sim can't do that. The draft's teardrop hairpin with legs that don't cross is the right reading.
findings.suggestedFix: No change needed. Builder: keep the teardrop shape and keep AC3's non-overlap check.

findings.claim: AC4 and AC5 add 25 single-bot laps and five six-car races to the test run, on top of the every-track suites that now include Hay Loop. That adds a lot of test time.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: share one run per seed across AC4's checks (laps, grass, props, stuck) rather than re-simulating per assertion.

backlogChangeRequests: B10's scope says 'A second track'; it is the third registered track (after bends and dust-bowl). Reword it to 'A new track'.
